description: This file defines a Perl class 'Coocook::Schema::ResultSet::Terms' which extends a ResultSet class, providing methods for ordering and filtering 'Terms' records based on date criteria within a database schema.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::ResultSet::Terms
classes.description: A Perl class representing a database result set for 'Terms', providing methods to order and filter terms based on date.

methods.name: order
methods.description: Returns a search result ordered by 'valid_from' date, either ascending or descending based on the input parameter.

methods.name: valid_on_date_rs
methods.description: Returns a result set of terms valid on a specific date, ordered by 'valid_from' descending.

methods.name: valid_on_date
methods.description: Fetches a single row of terms valid on a specific date.

methods.name: valid_today_rs
methods.description: Returns a result set of terms valid today.

methods.name: valid_today
methods.description: Fetches a single row of terms valid today.
